抖音会话界面契约：390px入口、扫码检查、取消与清除

checks: waiting_confirmation is accepted as the tenth status and displays phone-confirmation/automatic-verification guidance
The state remains active even with browser_open=false, so explicit check and cancellation remain available
QR and QR restart are hidden even if an older qr_available=true is received
After qr_available becomes false, the image stays hidden
The explicit check sends the existing POST check; no extra POST login occurs before the user later chooses re-login
UI guidance states that check does not refresh the login challenge; this UI contract does not itself prove a real upstream nonce was preserved
The existing login/check/clear/cancel flow and no-horizontal-overflow assertions pass in both viewports
boundary: Only the affected desktop/mobile cases were rerun. Session responses and local non-QR PNG are explicitly mocked; no real scan, phone confirmation, user session, model, GitHub or Feishu service was used.
history_note: The previous 4-test QR report and its screenshots retain their earlier index-BNpAMcPi.js build identity; they were not overwritten or relabeled as a final four-test rerun. The independent earlier workbench 5-test report also remains unchanged.
